concept_definition: Whether all leaf disposition/conclusion descriptions remain visible in the guideline. 0: at least one leaf is replaced by an existing deletion or neutral placeholder; 1: leaf descriptions contain none of those placeholders. Protected leaves may remain. Swapped substantive leaf descriptions still receive 1. This is disposition-text visibility, not a claim to label every form of interference.

training_config.objective: Iteratively fit a linear concept classifier and remove its row space
training_config.selection: Maximize dev endpoint truth accuracy; tie-break by lower dev disposition-concept balanced accuracy, then fewer iterations
training_config.selection_scope: All unique labeled dev pair-endpoint prompts, not test data

original_readout: Fixed original Qwen3 RMSNorm and original FP32 yes/no output rows
training_cost_scope: CPU erasure fitting/probes/dev selection plus measured original-prompt feature extraction when available. Original features are shared with CAA; this accounting charges their measured extraction cost once to an independent INLP run. No CAA target-completion work is charged to INLP.
implementation_differences: Author src/debias.py and src/classifier.py unchanged; isolated import namespace
New text-defined disposition visibility labels and E1 unique-prompt data adapter
Deterministic supported logistic classifier; no pairwise task loss
Fixed final-prompt-token residual location and fixed original RMSNorm/head
Exact low-rank basis storage with author dense projection retained
readout_protocol: Fixed original Qwen3 RMSNorm and original output rows
scoring_policy: All pair views plus all dynamically visited natural/interference path nodes; no gold labels used to choose nodes.
timing_scope: Prompt lookup and scorer callback only; model loading and training are excluded. Cached validation has no model inference cost.
